runs.temporal_findings: 约 8–12 分钟发现并使用外来证书；17–21 分钟出现 Research07 的多来源整合；24–35 分钟出现 Research08↔Research06 的往返改进；38–41 分钟多个汇总者重叠写主稿，未见已接受的任务分配。

delegation_review.scope: No same-task accepted A→B→C execution-and-return chain established in the retained reviewed evidence; this is not proof none occurred outside observation.

previous_findings.communication_path: Actual reads, checker executions, revisions and integrations through the shared publication files; zero recognized JSON messages is not zero communication.
previous_findings.temporal_description: Overlapping independent research -> first foreign constants read -> overlapping complete main drafts -> distinct supplements and multi-source integration -> iterative reciprocal refinements -> several late full consolidations -> real-file continuation then infrastructure censoring.
previous_findings.math_scope: Conditional results and limitations retained; their correctness and originality are not certified by agent consensus.

limitations: Retrospective operator annotation, not an independent blinded replication.
One-way denotes a verified directed episode with no verified return in that episode; not absence of all reverse flow.
Windows record evidence completion, not exact onset, persistence, disappearance or causality.
Unknown is outside the grid. No peer receipt is not inferred from no JSON messages or peer exit.
An integration hub is structural evidence; it does not alone certify an orchestrator.
Original scores, registrations and runtime failures remain unchanged.
